profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a McLean, Virginia based public company, traded as APPN, that describes itself as providing AI automation for critical business processes at large organizations. According to its website, the Appian Platform lets customers orchestrate AI agents, systems, and people on a unified platform without replacing their existing systems, and the company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years. The site presents the platform around process automation, artificial intelligence, and legacy application modernization, with stated uses in finance and accounting, sourcing and procurement, case management, compliance and audit, onboarding, order management, and contract review. Appian describes itself as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies and cites a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors.

The site's AI positioning centers on giving AI reliability and control, embedding AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts, and building AI-powered applications without code. Appian also points to an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services and to an ebook on choosing an agentic orchestration model. One site claim says AI automation can cut onboarding time by up to 50 percent.

The company's record shows a CIK of 0001441683 and a Virginia law exposure count of 152. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it.
